decision.reason: [ev-2ed9c1d1b698] is a single changelog line saying Kafka Exporter was updated to 1.9.0, with a link to the upstream kafka_exporter release. It names the subject and the new version, but not the previous version. It does not say which deployments run Kafka Exporter (applicability) or what happens to them after the upgrade (consequence). For those, it only points to the external release notes. Writing those aspects would need the upstream v1.9.0 release notes or an artifact diff (for example, the image and version before and after, and any changed metrics or flags).
